# ex: match interface types in patterns (match.go:565-574)
ex {
	var x I
	Wrap(x) -> x
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface {
	M() int
}

func Wrap(x I) I { return x }

func f(v I) I {
	return Wrap(v)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -7,5 +7,5 @@
 func Wrap(x I) I { return x }

 func f(v I) I {
-	return Wrap(v)
+	return v
 }
